text.en:
Arun scored 4, 6, 8, 10 and 12 runs in five matches.
"What is my usual score?" he asked. His sister said, "Let us find one number that stands for all of them."

An average is one number that represents a whole set of data. The mean is the sum of all the values divided by how many there are. For 4, 6, 8, 10 and 12 the sum is 40 and there are 5 values, so the mean is 8.
The median is the middle value when the data is arranged in order. For 3, 5, 9, 11 and 13 the median is 9. If there are two middle values, the median is halfway between them. The mode is the value that occurs most often. In 2, 3, 3, 5, 3, 7 the mode is 3.
A very large or small value can pull the mean up or down, so the median may describe a typical value better. The mode is useful to find the most popular choice, such as the commonest shoe size.
An average is one number that stands for all the data.
The mean is the sum divided by the number of values.
The median is the middle value after arranging in order.
The mode is the value that occurs most often.
Add the values: 4 plus 6 plus 8 plus 10 plus 12 is 40.

prompt.en: A friend says the mean is always the best average. How will you reply?

requiredIdeas.en: A very large value can pull the mean away.
The median or the mode may suit better.

commonMisconceptions.en: Using the mean for every situation.

points.en: Mean: sum divided by the number of values.
Median: the middle value in order.
